company.title:
Another $100M just went into institutional crypto infrastructure.

@tether invested $100M in @Anchor
company.description:
Another $100M just went into institutional crypto infrastructure.

@tether invested $100M in @Anchorage. This follows its earlier investment in @t0network.

Anchorage is the first federally regulated digital asset bank in the U.S. It provides custody, staking, settlement, and stablecoin services for institutions.

Tether already works with Anchorage to issue $USDT in the U.S., so this move deepens an existing partnership and strengthens the regulated banking layer behind USDT.

When you zoom out, the strategy becomes clear.

Anchorage handles regulated custody.
t0 focuses on tokenized settlement rails.

Together, these moves push USDT deeper into traditional finance infrastructure.

It's a meaningful step for crypto toward deeper institutional adoption.
A step that can have a long-term impact on this space.
